purpose: SimuNow architectural-light Pitch Deck v1; concept visuals, not simulation results

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production hero image for an English SimuNow pitch deck cover, 16:9 landscape, high-resolution premium architectural presentation, light background.
Primary request: an exceptionally refined architectural axonometric cutaway of one small office that visually connects building geometry with computational airflow reasoning. White and very pale cool gray background, no text anywhere. The entire LEFT 38 percent must remain nearly pure white and quiet for a large editable title; put the room in the RIGHT 62 percent. Leave generous white space above and below. Room geometry should be fully visible with no cropped walls or chairs.
Subject: one realistic rectangular office with floor slab, two partial sectioned walls, slender window frames, four desks and six simple office chairs, one high wall-mounted split AC. Crisp exact edges, beautifully restrained white architectural model materials, tiny pale-gray details, soft physically grounded ambient shadows, orthographic isometric camera. Less photoreal decoration; greater geometric legibility. No people, no plants, no laptops as focus.
Computational visual language: many elegant thin pale-cyan and muted teal airflow streamlines leaving the AC supply opening and curving through occupied space, fanning gently around furniture, then some broad recirculation arcs in the room. Lines are precise and readable, varied but controlled, not glowy fog. Add very subtle graphite construction lines extending from key room corners, faint projected floor-grid geometry, sparse fine computational mesh strokes on a couple of semi-transparent sectional planes. These geometric lines communicate spatial modeling and numerical reasoning, with a few delicate trajectory direction hints. They must not look like fake measured results: no numerical scale, no values, no labels, no formula symbols, no temperature heatmap, no purported CFD screenshot.
Composition: premium product launch visual meets architecture practice model study, calm, generous whitespace, tangible structure, cool white base #FFFFFF and pale gray #EDF1F3; ink graphite #20282C; a restrained cyan/teal #57BCC7 accent for flow. Lines may extend delicately into the lower left margin but the upper-left title area must stay blank. Avoid dark backgrounds, sci-fi HUD, neon, cards, ornamental bars, blue smoke, thick ribbons, rainbow colors, branding, text, watermarks. This is an artistic concept illustration for an early-stage P0 product, not a simulation result.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: supporting architecture illustration for slide 2 of an English SimuNow concept pitch deck, light background, no text. Reference image is used ONLY for consistency of office furniture, materials and restrained linework; create a new camera and composition.
Create a premium architectural top-down oblique office plan study, nearly overhead rather than the reference's low isometric view. Keep one office with a split AC on the upper-right wall, multiple workstations and six seats visible. Show why different seating positions are worth analyzing: precise slender cyan flow trajectories fan from the AC across the room, some curve around partitions and desks; seat locations are subtly delineated by simple pale-gray circular analysis rings in the floor plane. Use no thermal heatmap or performance numbers. Crisp fine graphite building edges, sparse light projected construction grid, semi-transparent wall edges, clean white model furniture, physically sensible office proportions, high-end architectural product presentation.
Composition: centered room occupies 80 percent of a landscape canvas about 3:2, generous clean white edge margin, full geometry visible, neither title nor text, no people, no plants. Cool white #FFFFFF and #F1F4F5 with graphite edges #59636A and restrained pale cyan #57BCC7 lines. Flat subtle lighting and grounded ambient shadows. Artistic concept, not a measured or simulated result. Avoid all text, equations, scales, labels, dimensions, neon, thick arrows, smoke and glossy UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium architectural exploded model illustration for the SimuNow English pitch deck's room-inputs slide. Use the supplied reference only for pale architectural material language; the new image is a different drawing, with no airflow ribbons.
A precisely crafted white architectural office model, isometric axonometric camera, vertically exploded into three aligned spatial layers: floor slab at bottom with a fine graphite coordinate grid; in the middle, four simple workstation desk modules with six chairs, one split AC and minimal partition geometry; above, separated white wall and window frame sections floating in registration with the floor. Use subtle fine graphite dotted registration lines between the corners, a few clear thin construction edges extending into the surrounding whitespace, and restrained muted teal outlines on the AC and two seat sampling locations. No measurements or dimension numerals. No text, labels, diagrams with words, formulas, people, plants, heatmap, scales, UI or scene outside the room. It is a physical-model explanation of room geometry, occupancy and HVAC inputs, not a computed result.
The model is centered in a wide 3:2 landscape frame with white clean margins, perfectly visible geometry and generous whitespace. High-end architecture office study, cool white #FFFFFF and soft gray #F0F3F5, graphite edges and a minimal teal #57BCC7 accent, soft natural ambient occlusion, clean precision, physically credible geometry, calm editorial simplicity. Avoid dark colors, heavy linework, thick borders, neon, oversaturated teal and dramatic shadows.
